summary: Day 12 of 72 (Time, Speed & Distance 1: Average Speed & Proportionality): Grasp inverse proportionality between Speed and Time when Distance is constant. Calculate harmonic mean average speed.

urgent_alerts.title: APS India Courier Document Dispatch
urgent_alerts.action: Courier physical document packet (Semesters 1–8 marksheets, degree certificate, DigiLocker consent) to APS New Delhi.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Dedicated Job Outreach Application Batch
blocks.details: Dedicated morning batch: Submit 8–10 tailored applications on Instahyre and LinkedIn Jobs. Target Series A–C tech and European remote roles highlighting Immediate Joiner status.

blocks.title: CAT Day 12: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: 20 Questions on TSD proportionality: Late by 10 mins vs early by 5 mins problems and meeting points on straight line.. DILR: Circular Arrangements with Variable Attributes (e.g. 6 people, 6 colors, facing alternating in/out). Anastasis Set 8..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 12: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: CL MyZone VARC: Verbal Ability Module 2 - Para Summary mechanics. Identify the core premise vs supporting illustration. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
